gizmo.title: Numeric question
gizmo.description: A question answered with a number. The answer is a fixed number or a formula worked out from variables, and counts when it is within a tolerance.

configure.title: Question
configure.description: What learners are asked. Write a variable name in braces, like {d}, to show its value.

configure.title: Unit
configure.description: Shown as text beside the answer field, for example km/h.

configure.title: Answer
configure.description: The correct number. Leave empty when a formula works the answer out.

configure.title: Formula
configure.description: Works the answer out from the variables, for example d / (t / 60). Can use + - * / ^, parentheses, sqrt() and abs(). Used instead of the answer when set.

configure.title: Variables
configure.description: Numbers the formula and the question use. Each one takes a value between its lowest and highest, in steps.

properties.title: Name
properties.description: Letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

advanced.title: Tolerance
advanced.description: How far from the exact answer still counts. 0 means exact, or rounded to the decimal places below.

advanced.title: Tolerance type
advanced.description: Absolute: plus or minus the tolerance. Percent: plus or minus that percent of the exact answer.

advanced.title: Decimal places
advanced.description: Learners are asked to round to this many places, and the answer is shown rounded to it. Leave empty for no rounding.

advanced.title: Attempts
advanced.description: How many times a learner can check. 0 means unlimited.

advanced.title: New numbers on every try
advanced.description: Draw new variable values each time a learner tries again. Their earlier answer is then not shown when they come back, only whether they got it right.

advanced.title: Collapsible
advanced.description: Show this question as a row that opens and closes. Opening one closes the other collapsible questions beside it.

advanced.title: Start collapsed
advanced.description: When collapsible, start as a closed row that shows only the question and its status.

developer.title: Name of the quiz
developer.description: Quiz name used for xAPI identification in analytics systems.

properties.question: A cyclist rides {d} km in {t} minutes. What is her average speed?

demoSchema.content:
The time is in minutes but the answer is per hour.

Speed is distance divided by time in hours.
